title: Anti-flea Collar usage
content: The Anti-flea Collar — All Breeds is a lightweight, adjustable, water-resistant collar effective for up to 8 months against fleas and ticks. Priced at 95 EGP. Suitable for both cats and dogs.

title: Multivitamin Supplement Drops
content: The Multivitamin Supplement Drops support immune health, joints, and coat condition. Add directly to food or water daily. Priced at 75 EGP. Consult a vet before combining with other supplements.

title: Never give human medication to pets
content: Common human medications like paracetamol, ibuprofen, and aspirin are toxic to dogs and cats and should never be given without explicit veterinary guidance. If a pet has ingested human medication, treat it as a poisoning emergency.

title: Antibiotic courses
content: If a vet prescribes antibiotics, always complete the full course even if symptoms improve early, to prevent resistance and relapse.
